security.evidence: Every ability resolves the actor's role scoped to the record's entity (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:52-56, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:52-55), so cross-entity access is denied (tests/Feature/EntityMembershipPolicyTest.php:32-35, EntityPolicyTest.php:63-69); the owner membership can be neither deleted nor reassigned (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:23-36); mass assignment is restricted via #[Fillable] and the generated owner_seq column is not fillable (database/migrations/2026_10_29_042649_create_entity_memberships_table.php:21-23); no user input, views or Livewire code in this diff.

tests.evidence: Comprehensive Pest coverage: schema constraints including the named indexes, default role, owner_seq values and rejection of a second owner (tests/Feature/EntityMembershipSchemaTest.php:78-110), cascade deletes (same file:129-143), model relations/route binding/scopes (tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:11-135), every policy ability with non-member and other-entity denials (EntityPolicyTest.php:12-69, EntityMembershipPolicyTest.php:8-83), and the enum (tests/Unit/UserRoleTest.php:6-13). simplicity.evidence: Small, direct files: one enum, two models, two policies and two factories; Entity::owner() reuses the scope instead of duplicating the query (app/Models/Entity.php:55-58) and both policies share a private roleIn() helper (EntityPolicy.php:52-56, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:52-55). No service/repository layer, no dead code.

readability.evidence: Names and docblocks match the existing style of app/Models/User.php; policies stay short by delegating to membershipFor()/roleIn(); the migration comment explains the generated-column trick (database/migrations/2026_10_29_042649_create_entity_memberships_table.php:21-23); no debug output or leftover code.

scope.evidence: The diff contains only the models, enum, policies, factories, two migrations, their tests and the docs the task names (docs/database-schema.md, docs/business-rules.md) plus CHANGELOG.md; no routes, Livewire, session or page work from the out-of-scope list.

issues.explanation: assignRole() rejects any role assignment on the owner's membership, even when performed by the owner or an admin, although the task only says that owner and admin may assign roles; the extra rule (documented as ownership-transfer separation) is defensible but goes beyond the stated contract and is baked into a test.
The file declares global helper functions (indexNamed, insertMembership), which risk name collisions as the Pest suite grows; a closure or test class would be safer.

review.summary: The change implements the entity/membership persistence, models, enum, factories and both policies, with the database enforcing one owner per entity via the generated owner_seq column, and adds thorough schema/model/policy tests plus the required doc updates. Only one behavioral deviation from the task text was found: assignRole also forbids assigning a role to the owner's membership, which the change documents as the ownership-transfer invariant but the task did not request.
